traits.note: Club mosses are seedless vascular plants that spread by spores; their sporangia sit on sporophylls gathered into cones, strobili (Biology 2e, 25.4).

traits.woodiness.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), the lycophyte families Lycopodiaceae (evergreen herbs), Selaginellaceae (moss-like plants) and Isoetaceae (quillworts, rosettes on a corm-like stem): none has wood. A few Selaginella species are called woody (dendroid) there, too few to state.
